items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: G1-G5 built as kit classes (thread/comment-tree, master-detail with picker, count slot, callout+copy-btn, eyebrow); G6 verify-only, not built; derived from Untitled UI tab badge, feed item, code snippet per operator note.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Static CSS and HTML fragments; no runtime paths.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No scripts, no external assets, no inline event handlers added.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Two tests assert narrow-screen picker collapse, nested replies, count slot in both switchers, mono eyebrow; existing kit tests cover tokens-only, gallery coverage, example currency.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: About 40 CSS lines; no layout thrash; sticky pane only.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Classes follow existing kebab/prefix naming; new sections commented like neighbours; docs table and derivation note updated.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Kit class inventory vs gallery, snippets and token contract: all consumer tests green; no new tokens.
